rows.note: Use this for foam or lather made by mixing soap and water; it is the all-purpose rendering for this sense.

example.english: Adding a little detergent when doing laundry makes lots of suds.
example.traditional: 洗衫嗰陣加少少洗衣液，就會有好多肥皂泡沫。
example.jyutping: sai2 saam1 go2 zan6 gaa1 siu2 siu2 sai2 ji1 jik6 zau6 wui6 jau5 hou2 do1 fei4 zou6 pou5 mut6

rows.note: Use this when “suds” is casual slang for beer, especially in a food-and-drink context.

example.english: We ordered some suds to go with our burgers.
example.traditional: 我哋食漢堡嗰陣叫咗幾杯啤酒。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 sik6 hon3 bou2 go2 zan6 giu3 zo2 gei2 bui1 be1 zau2
